name: Visual Paradigm
description: A broad commercial modeling suite with UML, use-case specifications, textual analysis, code-to-sequence reverse engineering, requirements management, reporting, and ArchiMate support.
editorialNote: Imported from the UMLChina UML tools collection. The English summary is a concise editorial translation; capability fields remain Unknown unless the source explicitly states support.
sourceDescriptionZh: 18.0版本已经宣称AI驱动。很用心的UML建模工具。支持编写用例规约。支持文本分析和CRC卡。支持自定义形状或导入Visio的图形。Java代码转序列图。有需求管理功能。可用性好，图形漂亮。报表生成，影响分析。业务规则编辑器，对企业架构语言ArchiMate的支持。
